title: Clouds
html:
Clouds are a type of area. Clouds hang directly above the ground, as opposed to surfaces that coat the ground itself.

Properties

Clouds generally apply their effects when a character enters their zone of influence. Beyond this, most clouds are more specific and individualized in their effects. Some clouds apply an additional effect when beginning or ending a turn within the cloud; some clouds' effects only persist while within the cloud, while others apply conditions that persist after leaving.

Clouds can be removed by  Gust of Wind and  Rush of the Gale Spirits.

Unlike surfaces, clouds are not dippable.

Types of clouds

Surface Effects
 Cloudkill
  • Takes 5d8⁠⁠Poison damage every turn.
 Crawler Mucus
  •  Poisons and  Paralyses those within
 Darkness
  •  Blinds those within and blocks ranged attacks in/out.
 Drow Poison Cloud
  • Those within may become  Poisoned and fall  Asleep
 Electrified Steam
  • Applies  Wet to creatures within.
  •  Electrocuted - Take 1d4⁠⁠Lightning damage per turn.
 Fog
  •  Blinds those within and blocks ranged attacks in/out.
 Haste Spores
  • Grants +2 Armour Class, double movement speed and an extra Action to those within.
 Ice Cloud
  • Deals 10d6⁠⁠Cold damage to those within the cloud.
 Malice
  • Those within may become  Poisoned and  Blinded
 Noxious Fumes
  • Deals 1d4⁠⁠Poison + 2d4⁠⁠Poison (CON save for half) damage per turn.
 Pacifying Spores
  • Prevents actions, bonus actions, and reactions from those inside the cloud.
 Poison Cloud
  • Chance to  Poisoned those within.
 Potion of Greater Healing
  • Recover 4d4+4⁠⁠Hit Points and stop  Burning.
 Potion of Healing
  • Recover 2d4+2⁠⁠Hit Points and stop  Burning.
 Potion of Superior Healing
  • Recover 8d4+8⁠⁠Hit Points and stop  Burning.
 Potion of Supreme Healing
  • Recover 10d4+20⁠⁠Hit Points and stop  Burning.
 Steam Cloud
  • Applies  Wet to creatures within.
 Stinking Cloud
  • Prevents creatures within from taking Actions.
 Strange Gas
  • Weakens non-Gith creatures by granting them vulnerability to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
  • Strengthens Gith creatures by granting them resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
 Timmask Spores
  • Chance to  Befuddle creatures within.
 Void
  • Chance to  Blind creatures within.
  • Characters will also take ⁠⁠Cold damage at the end of each turn.
